revision_note: The v1 run is preserved. Before this v2 run, RSS instrumentation was corrected and a 64-slot sparse sensitivity case was added after observing different queue occupancy. This is an exploratory follow-up, not a pre-registered confirmation.
expectations: Borrow retains full source allocations for small selections.
Copy can add CPU and transient source plus destination memory for dense selections.
A current-pressure rule need not outperform a static size rule or early projection.
Pool reuse can reduce allocation calls while increasing reserved idle memory.
No Pure-specific advantage, application SLO, or statistical significance is presumed.
comparison_rule: Report all presets and repetitions; no post-hoc winner is called an out-of-sample tuned policy.
limits: Single FIFO local pipeline with synthetic delayed sink. No Sonic/Node/.NET benchmark, fan-out, persistent cache, generic JSON parser, external open-loop arrivals, or production SLO.
